objects.label: Large reflective panel between the two dark shelving bays
objects.identity_description: The continuous large glossy grey reflective panel flanked by narrow shelving on its left and the wider two-column shelving bay on its right. Include the panel surface and its thin edge only; exclude the separate dark base drawers and reflected furnishings. Do not assume its mechanism or hidden thickness.

objects.label: Right two-column dark shelving bay and its attached base cabinet
objects.identity_description: The dark shelving bay immediately right of the reflective panel, recognizable by a narrow left column containing the orange/yellow 36 book and a wider right column displaying a pale bowl above a dried-stem vase. Include the attached lower cabinet and outer frame, not the white wall trim. This is distinct from the narrower bay at the panel's left.

objects.label: Cream upholstered chaise beside the waterfront window
objects.identity_description: The cream chaise directly in front of the window, between the large potted plant on its left and the small sculptural side table on its right in anchor frame 5. Track the upholstered furniture body and fitted cushions, not the bed in the foreground or a reflection in the glossy wall panel. The rust and blue loose pillows and pale draped throw are identity cues, not separate extensions of the furniture geometry.

objects.label: Large broadleaf indoor plant in a dark floor pot

Track the plant-and-planter assembly; exclude outdoor palms, the small bust/table beside the chaise, and all appearances reflected in the glossy wall panel.

objects.label: Round black wall clock
